items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: You know, made that copy of the Four Piece Band with Burbank. Yeah. And let's see, who else was on it now? Talbot. ... Talbot. And Lester Lewis on piano, myself and Albert Buerbank.

ctx.x: Remember that? That's right. That's right. I remember that very well. No.

Had you made any other records? We know you made that one little record that we just copied. You know, made that copy of the Four Piece Band with Burbank. Yeah. And let's see, who else was on it now? Talbot. Oh, yes.
Talbot. And Lester Lewis on piano, myself and Albert Buerbank.
